items.title: Core product positioning
items.summary: PHIGuard is a HIPAA operations hub for small clinics and growing healthcare organizations.
items.body:
Primary CTA:
Start free trial (https://my.phiguard.app/signup).
Product pillars:
Recurring HIPAA tasks and audit history: Assign recurring clinic work, keep its full history, and tie each task to the person who owns it.
Checklists, evidence, and exports: Start from HIPAA checklists and templates instead of rebuilding the program in shared docs or spreadsheets.
Policies, training, risk, and vendor BAAs: Add advanced Group-plan program modules for policies, training records, risk work, and vendor BAA tracking.
Incidents and response history: Write down events, keep response steps visible, and save incident history in the same system as the rest of the program.
Multi-location reporting and Group controls: Support larger clinics and multi-site groups that need shared visibility, integrations, and stronger evidence handling.

items.title: Public trust claims
items.summary: Reusable public trust claims for BAA coverage, audit history, pricing, and conservative security posture.
items.body:
BAA at every plan: You get a signed BAA from your first login. You do not have to ask for an enterprise plan to get it.
Append-only audit history: Task actions, evidence, incident updates, and program work build a lasting record you can review later.
Per-clinic pricing: You pay one price for the clinic. We do not charge per user for each admin, provider, and coordinator.
Plain security claims: Our security pages tell you what the product does today. We do not claim certifications we have not earned.

items.title: Generic tool comparison
items.summary: PHIGuard is the better fit when your clinic needs a BAA at every plan, audit history, per-clinic pricing, and compliance tasks, incidents, vendors, and policies in one system.
items.body:
PHIGuard fits small clinics that need HIPAA work handled, not another generic workspace.
PHIGuard is not the best fit for every buyer. Enterprise teams with broad GRC needs, deep custom development, or non-clinic collaboration should compare those needs directly.
Business Associate Agreement: Included at every plan vs Often not offered, or held for enterprise buyers
Audit-ready task history: Append-only audit trail vs Activity feed or mutable history
Pricing model: Flat clinic pricing vs Per-user cost growth
Recurring compliance work: HIPAA-oriented tasks, checklists, and evidence vs Generic project templates or none
Incident response process: Structured incident tracking in-product vs Usually managed outside the tool

items.title: Reusable public pricing and trial copy
items.summary: Canonical marketing page copy for public pricing, trial, no-card, BAA, and audit posture claims.
items.body:
Per-clinic pricing. BAA at every tier.
PHIGuard gives practice administrators a calmer way to run compliance work. One clinic price, an immutable audit trail, and guardrails that generic task tools do not give you.
Every plan includes a signed Business Associate Agreement and an immutable audit trail. No enterprise contracts. No surprise scaling costs.
What should a small clinic choose first?: Most small clinics choose Essentials when they need the HIPAA baseline and not the extra structure of the higher plans.
When does Clinic make more sense?: Clinic fits better once your practice has more coordination, more users, or a need for calendar and integration support.
What pushes an organization to Group?: Group is for multi-location reporting and advanced compliance work, such as policy, training, vendor, risk, and SOC 2 evidence management.
Do you offer a custom path?: Yes. Compliance Ops is a custom path for teams that need hands-on compliance support. It is not a public price card.
Can we just start a trial instead of talking to sales?: Yes. Self-serve trial signup is the main action, and you do not need a credit card to start.

items.title: Public legal and trust FAQs
items.summary: Reusable public FAQ answers for BAA coverage and audit-trail claims.
items.body:
What is a Business Associate Agreement (BAA)?: A Business Associate Agreement is a legally required HIPAA contract between your clinic and any vendor that handles Protected Health Information for you. It sets out how the vendor may use PHI and the safeguards it must keep.
Do you sign BAAs on every pricing tier?: Yes. PHIGuard includes a signed Business Associate Agreement at every pricing tier. You do not have to negotiate an enterprise contract to get basic legal coverage.
Does PHIGuard create an audit trail for HIPAA compliance?: Yes. Every relevant task action is recorded in an immutable audit log, so your clinic has solid evidence for reviews, investigations, and recurring compliance work.

items.title: Public security posture
items.summary: Public-safe security page claims for safeguards, telemetry boundaries, audit controls, and encryption posture.
items.body:
Encryption and transport protections: App traffic runs over HTTPS, and managed infrastructure encrypts stored data at rest.
Access and identity boundaries: The product uses unique user logins and role-based access, so each action ties back to the person who did it.
Append-only audit behavior: Audit events are kept in an append-only record. They are not treated like a feed you can edit.
Marketing and app telemetry separation: Analytics stay on the public site. The signed-in product does not load third-party marketing scripts.
Access control: Role-based access and unique user logins keep clinic actions tied to a person.
Audit controls: Product activity is kept in an append-only audit record, not a feed you can edit.
Transmission security: HTTPS/TLS protects app traffic in transit.
Stored data protection: Managed infrastructure encrypts stored data at rest.
Telemetry boundary: Public-site analytics stay separate from the signed-in app.
